This operational experience demonstrated that an AI- enabled platform can improve the speed, consistency, analytical rigor, and educational value of wargame development and execution.   1. Description of Services

The consulting services (“the Services”) include: Task 1: Africa RISE User Requirements Assessment: Map and profile all user groups and partners including relevant African Union agencies and departments (AUDANEPAD, AU-SAFGRAD, SEBE), government ministries, transboundary water management agencies, regulators, MPA focal points, implementing partners, research institutes and universities and technical experts, farmers, aggregators, private sector, equipment suppliers and financial institutions and farmer unions and cooperative societies etc; Task 2: Design, Develop and Commission the Africa RISE Gateway: Define system architecture, data structures, modules, dashboard requirements and proc

Task 4: Sustainable Operation and Maintenance (O&M) Model for the Gateway: Assess the technical and operational requirements for sustained operation of the Gateway, including hosting, security, data management, updates, user support and maintenance schedules and prepare indicative annual cost projections for the post-project period. Specifically, pursuant to RFO FAR 12.201-1(c)(2), the Contracting Officer may solicit from a single source for purchases not exceeding the Simplified Acquisition Threshold (SAT) if the Contracting Officer determines that only one source is reasonably available. Sole Source Justification Details Exclusive Proprietary Ownership: Battlespace Simulations, Inc. (BSI) is the sole developer, intellectual property owner, and exclusive licensor of both the MACE and ARMOR software applications. This will be an addition to the current ATD-GCMS in the Fires team of the Chemistry department to be able to deal with the volume of fire cases submitted to FSI. Materials submitted for analysis ignitable liquids include debris samples taken from a fire scene, clothing taken from suspects or victims, or any other solid sample where it is desired to determine whether or not there are ignitable liquids associated with it. Such samples are submitted to the Laboratory in sealed nylon bags. f_Work.docx ===== STATEMENT OF WORK (SOW) RFID Cabinet The Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), Veterans Health Administration (VHA), requires the acquisition of a Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) storage cabinet integrated with Unique Device Identifier (UDI)-compliant tissue and implant tracking software to support patient safety, regulatory compliance, and efficient inventory management. Tracking tissues, biologics, and implantable medical devices is a federal regulatory requirement under FDA 21 CFR Part 830 (UDI) and is critical to patient safety. VA healthcare facilities face ongoing resource challenges including staff shortages and budget constraints, making it essential to minimize staff time consumed by manual data entry and to maintain precise control over high-value inventory. This acquisition will provide an automated, real-time RFID-based inventory management solution for use in the operating room (OR), Catheterization (Cath) lab, ambulatory surgery center, or any facility location that stores high-value implantable inventory. Description The Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), Veterans Health Administration (VHA), requires one (1) InVita UDTracker® RFID Cabinet — consisting of Terso Solutions RFID cabinet hardware integrated with InVita's UDTracker® tissue and implant

The Naval Surface Warfare Center Carderock Division (NSWCCD) intends to solicit and award a firm-fixed-price contract to only one source under the authority of FAR 13.106-1(b)(1)(i). The Contracting Officer has determined that the circumstances of this contract action deem only one source reasonably available due to proprietary data restrictions, software copyrights, and specialized Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) calibration req uirements.
